verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications platform, so recurring scheduled jobs or workflows (such as recurring messages or automations) is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents an API, an MCP server, call routing and the Sona AI agent, but nothing about scheduling or recurring execution. One-off actions like sending a text or broadcast do not amount to a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
